response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat AS st, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), base AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS baseline FROM g), q AS (SELECT g.st, g.avg_conf FROM g, base WHERE g.avg_conf > base.baseline), qm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS qmean FROM q) SELECT q.st AS brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS avg_modelconf, q.avg_conf - base.baseline AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / qm.qmean AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q, base, qm WHERE base.baseline IS NOT NULL AND qm.qmean IS NOT NULL
